project.description: LNMP 项目 CI/CD：检出 -> 检查 -> 构建 -> 部署 -> 验证

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: set -e echo "===== 阶段 1：检出代码 =====" cd /opt/lnmp git log -1 --oneline
set -e echo "===== 阶段 2：配置语法检查 =====" cd /opt/lnmp docker compose config -q echo "compose 配置校验通过"
set -e echo "===== 阶段 3：构建镜像 =====" cd /opt/lnmp DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 docker build -t lnmp/php:build-${BUILD_NUMBER} ./php docker tag lnmp/php:build-${BUILD_NUMBER} lnmp/php:1.0 echo "镜像构建完成"
set -e echo "===== 阶段 4：部署 =====" cd /opt/lnmp docker compose up -d php nginx echo "部署完成"

set -e echo "===== 阶段 5：冒烟测试 =====" check() { for i in $(seq 1 12); do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 "$1") if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then echo "$2 通过 ($code)"; return 0; fi echo " 等待中... 第 $i 次: $code"; sleep 5 done echo "$2 失败: $code"; return 1 } check http://nginx:80/ "应用首页" check http://nginx:80/app/ "Tomcat 应用" echo "所有冒烟测试通过"
